INSERT IGNORE INTO t_appointment (appt_no, schedule_id, patient_id, doctor_id, visit_date, seq_no, visit_time, status, fee_cents, pay_deadline, event_id) VALUES
(#{p.apptNo}, #{p.scheduleId}, #{p.patientId}, #{p.doctorId}, #{p.visitDate}, #{p.seqNo}, #{p.visitTime}, 'PENDING_PAY', #{p.feeCents}, #{p.payDeadline}, #{p.eventId})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_appointment SET status='BOOKED', paid_at=#{now} WHERE appt_no=#{apptNo} AND status='PENDING_PAY'
UPDATE t_appointment SET status='REFUNDED', cancelled_at=#{now} WHERE appt_no=#{apptNo} AND status='BOOKED'
UPDATE t_appointment SET status='EXPIRED', cancelled_at=#{now} WHERE appt_no=#{apptNo} AND status='PENDING_PAY'
UPDATE t_appointment SET status='COMPLETED' WHERE appt_no=#{apptNo} AND status='BOOKED'
UPDATE t_appointment SET status='NO_SHOW' WHERE appt_no=#{apptNo} AND status='BOOKED'

UPDATE t_patient p SET p.no_show_count = p.no_show_count + 1, p.blocked_until = CASE WHEN p.no_show_count + 1 >= 3 THEN DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) ELSE p.blocked_until END WHERE p.id = (SELECT a.patient_id FROM t_appointment a WHERE a.appt_no=#{apptNo})
